C x.map-classification EX - MUST ;; Classify every instruction artifact by Capability (owned by the selected module of a replaceable slot, header 'Capability: <slot>/<implementation>', otherwise —), then Kind (OP, DEC, STD, KNW, WF, ENF, IN; decides mechanism and location), then Scope (decides rule directory and paths). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system classification rule.
C x.map-direction EX - MUST ;; Dependencies point WF → KNW → STD → DEC → OP and ENF → STD/DEC, declared on each ENF artifact's Conforms line; product inputs never override policy; skill and agent references are routing pointers; changes to the system go through template-maintenance (user-invoked) and capability-selection changes through architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system conformance rule.
